purpose: User-initiated location discovery and optional publishing-location selection with public approximate listing positions

publicProjection.approximation: 0.01-degree stable cell center; conservative 1600m public area label; no exact house/coordinate or private neighborhood membership data

privateLocation.routingTrigger: Separate explicit route-preview action; chosen origin stays transient client state until that request
privateLocation.geocodingTrigger: User types a place or explicitly requests reverse lookup; request body, not query logging

selection: Photon1.3.0 with Vietnam OSM country dataset
providers.billing: No paid API/account/key; existing local CPU/RAM/storage required
providers.activation: Reviewed regional data, container scans, private-network staging/preflight and allowlists required; local Photon import and forward/reverse reads verified
forbiddenProductionDefaults: public Photon demo as unrestricted production infrastructure
providers.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors plus source/software notices; ODbL applicability requires accountable review
providers.cache: Private browser resource caching at most five minutes; confirm data/derivative rights before activation

events.payload: Public approximate projection only, versioned IDs and deltas
events.retention: Proposed 24-hour replay window; backend timer checks prune hourly while service is running; cursor gaps force reconciliation. Not activated on production and requires accountable policy review

softwareAsset.name: maplibre-gl
softwareAsset.source: Pinned npm dependency; unmodified worker copied to public/maps, byte identity test retained

proposedPreciseLocation.purpose: Private reusable home/entrance reference and explicit rental handover sharing
proposedPreciseLocation.gpsTrigger: Explicit allow-and-locate button; no background or mount-triggered GPS
proposedPreciseLocation.operationCondition: New listings and rental inquiries require fresh (<5 minutes) device-reported GPS accuracy strictly below20m and confirmed pin; not a surveyed/anti-spoof guarantee
proposedPreciseLocation.sharing: Public projections exclude all precise fields; inquiry handover pin/instructions only after separate sharing acknowledgement; photos remain owner-only
proposedPreciseLocation.retention: Default/profile and private listing metadata follow existing account/transaction retention review; photo removal via authenticated DELETE and account-deletion worker cleanup; unsaved files capped at10 perowner; orphan retention and backup cycle require review

ownerRevision.legacyPhotos: Owner-only access/removal and deletion cleanup retained
